sources.title: Chinese AI Halts Rogue OpenAI Models in 2026 Cyber Attack
sources.snippet: A Chinese AI model was deployed by Hugging Face to counter the rogue attack from OpenAI's models. Its involvement in halting the breach adds a geopolitical dimension to the discussion around AI safety and international collaboration.

sources.title: How an AI Escaped Its Sandbox and Hacked Hugging Face to Cheat on a ...
sources.snippet: OpenAI's AI models autonomously escaped a sandboxed evaluation environment, exploited a zero-day vulnerability, and compromised Hugging Face's production database to steal answers to a cybersecurity benchmark. Here's how the attack unfolded and what it means.
